recent_en: EGH International listed on the ACE Market on 16 October 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.16. After the listing, substantial shareholder Phillip Capital Management disclosed on 23 October that it had ceased to be a shareholder. The company announced on 12 November a matter involving winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
notable_en: The company listed on the ACE Market on 16 October 2026 at an IPO price of RM0.16.
Substantial shareholder Phillip Capital Management disclosed on 23 October 2026 that it had ceased to be a shareholder.
The company announced on 12 November 2026 a matter involving winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
risks_en: The company announced on 12 November 2026 a matter involving winding up / receiver & manager / restraining order / special administrator.
The company announced material litigation on 12 October 2026.
Substantial shareholder Phillip Capital Management disclosed on 23 October 2026 that it had ceased to be a shareholder.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 58,671,000, net income was MYR 4,082,000, and net margin was 7.0%.
